question: What reaches relishing, and how much is the one?
premises: It reaches the path of relishing, variegated clear-and-unclear.
So much is this one alone, of manifest own-nature.
inference: Clear-unclear-variegated reaching of relishing measures the one manifest-natured.
uncertainties: Subject carried from the preceding floods.
plain_english: It reaches the path of relishing — variegated clear-and-unclear; so much is this one alone, of manifest own-nature.
